systems.name: Customer Data Warehouse

incidents.impact: Duplicate invoices issued to 12 customers over one billing run.
incidents.lesson: Billing System is critical and undocumented. The fix depended on one engineer reading the code.

incidents.impact: All deploys blocked for four hours after a CodeReviewAgent rule change rejected every pull request.
incidents.lesson: Agent configuration changes ship with no review step of their own.

incidents.impact: An exposed credential went undetected for 11 days.
incidents.lesson: Sarah Mitchell is both Responsible and Accountable for Security Audit Process, so nobody independent reviews the scanner configuration.

incidents.impact: An upstream schema change dropped two days of product events before anyone noticed.
incidents.lesson: No contract test between the producer and the pipeline.

incidents.impact: Indexing stalled silently for six days; workspace search returned stale results company-wide.
incidents.lesson: Indexing algorithms are undocumented and Nathan Wright is the only holder. Nothing alerted on a stalled job, so the outage was invisible until users complained.

incidents.impact: Agent went inactive unnoticed; three weeks of logs were never analysed.
incidents.lesson: An agent going quiet looks identical to an agent with nothing to do.

incidents.impact: On-call engineer had no runbook; time to mitigate ran to three times the target.
incidents.lesson: The Incident Response workflow is marked critical and is not documented. Yuki Tanaka owns it alongside DeployBot and IncidentResponder.

incidents.impact: Two enterprise customers stalled in onboarding for nine days each.
incidents.lesson: Onboarding is undocumented and its owner is a VP with no operational backup.

decisions_log.decision: Freeze onboarding of new AI agents until documentation coverage exceeds 80%.
factors: two incidents traced to undocumented agents
decisions_log.outcome: not enforced — four agents were added in Q1 regardless

decisions_log.decision: Run Claude Pro alongside ChatGPT Enterprise rather than consolidating onto one assistant.
Require a named backup owner for every critical agent, workflow and system.
decisions_log.outcome: partially implemented — several critical assets still have no backup owner

decisions_log.decision: Defer the KnowledgeIndexer rewrite to Q3 and keep the existing implementation.
decisions_log.outcome: reversed ten days later after the 10 April outage

decisions_log.decision: Cap monthly AI tool spend at $18,000 and require CFO approval above it.
factors: five tools have no governing policy

decisions_log.decision: Move SecurityScanner configuration into version control and require two reviewers.
